effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. If you have 3 or fewer security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes suspended, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon.
